name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.phi_pow_smul_mem_pointsOver
summary: φ^l moves the point to the letter i (phi_pow_mem_withExponents); its Galois differences are φ^l(zτ) times φ^l of zτ⁻¹(gw − w), and φ^l(zτ) is divisible by φ^aE for a < l, which raises the depth there by one.

steps.claim: φ^l w ∈ kisinLoc (phi_pow_mem_kisinLoc) and projTriv(φ^l w) = p^e·constantAt(S, i)(c) (phi_pow_smul_constantAt);
steps.lean:
⟨phi_pow_mem_kisinLoc hw.1, by simp [hw.2.1, smul_comm, phi_pow_smul_constantAt,
  Equiv.Perm.coe_inv],

steps.claim: its depth is frobExponent(l, 1, o'): g(φ^l w) − φ^l w = φ^l(zτ)·φ^l(zτ⁻¹(gw − w)); the second factor has exponents frobExponent(l, 0, o') (smul_sub_mem_kerWithExponents, phi_pow_mem_withExponents), and φ^l(τ) is divisible by φ^aE for a < l (frobE_dvd_phi_pow_tau), so multiplying by φ^l(zτ) raises the exponents at a < l by one (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff).
steps.lean:
fun g ↦ have Y := phi_pow_mem_withExponents (smul_sub_mem_kerWithExponents hw g).1
  Eq.subst (by simp [← frobGroup_smul_smul, ← zTauUnit_smul, smul_sub, smul_phi_pow_comm])
    (mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil (smul_mem _ (FrobGroup.φ ^ l • k.zTau) Y)
    fun a u v c μ e ↦ have c : a < l := by lia
    by simpa [c, zTau] using mul_mem_hodgeFil (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff.2
      ((frobE_dvd_phi_pow_tau c).mul_right _)) (Y.2 a u v μ e))⟩

steps.claim: at the places (a, u) where the exponent is raised, a < l;
steps.lean: have c : a < l := by lia

steps.claim: there φ^{−a}(φ^l(zτ)) ∈ hodgeFil(1) (φ^aE divides φ^l(τ), frobE_dvd_phi_pow_tau; phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff), so the product's value is in hodgeFil(value step + 1).
steps.lean:
by simpa [c, zTau] using mul_mem_hodgeFil (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff.2
      ((frobE_dvd_phi_pow_tau c).mul_right _)) (Y.2 a u v μ e))⟩
